title: A production alert the relay verified and recorded as a signed fact starts the alert agent, whose pull request changes the code and plans like any other, and an alert signed with another key starts nothing

steps.label: the base push applied the root
the relay takes a generic alert and records it on chant/lifecycle
the alert agent's workflow runs on main
the pull request's plan job went green

break.note: check.sh alert-post runs the relay with a relay key the repo's CHANT_RELAY_KEY secret does not hold, so the fact it records fails the agent job's signature check, the agent starts nothing and no pull request appears
